question.text: A common tangent <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>T</mi></math> to the curves <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>C</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>:</mo><mfrac><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mn>4</mn></mfrac><mo>+</mo><mfrac><msup><mi>y</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mn>9</mn></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>C</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>:</mo><mfrac><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mn>42</mn></mfrac><mo>-</mo><mfrac><msup><mi>y</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mn>143</mn></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></math> does not pass through the fourth quadrant. If <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>T</mi></math> touches <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>C</mi><mn>1</mn></msub></math> at <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced><mrow><msub><mi>x</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>,</mo><msub><mi>y</mi><mn>1</mn></msub></mrow></mfenced></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>C</mi><mn>2</mn></msub></math> at <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced><mrow><msub><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>,</mo><msub><mi>y</mi><mn>2</mn></msub></mrow></mfenced></math>, then <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced close="|" open="|"><mrow><mn>2</mn><msub><mi>x</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>+</mo><msub><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msub></mrow></mfenced></math> is equal to _______.

solution.text:
Given curve C1:x24+y29=1 and C2:x242-y2143=1

Now let common tangents to the curves are

T1:y=mx±4m2+9

and T2:y=mx±42m2-143

Since they both are same,

So, 4m2+9=42m2-143

⇒38 m2=152

⇒m=±2

So, c=±4m2+9=±5

For given tangent not pass through 4th quadrant

So, T:y=2x+5

Now, comparing with point form of tangent  xx14+yy19=1

We get, x18=-15⇒x1=-85

And point form of tangent equation of hyperbola xx242-yy2143=1 and 2x-y=-5

We get x2=-845

So 2x1+x2=-1005=20
